goal: Security hardening for login authentication and sending email for signing
decisions: Password complexity enforcement with real-time entropy calculation
Brute force defense with 60-second exponential backoff lockout after 5 failed attempts
MFA TOTP 6-digit challenge code and FIDO2 Passkey biometric login
Time-bound HMAC-SHA256 signer magic links with cryptographic tamper detection and 7-day expiration
Backend rate limiting (max 5 emails/10 min per recipient), CRLF injection defense, and HTML sanitization
